data.name: Usage
data.value:
srcsharp: authoring tools for SRC# data and scenarios
Usage: srcsharp lint <directory or file>... [--format text|sarif] [--output file] [--rules src,gsc-robo,gsc-ext,robodun|none] [--list-rules] [--app-path SRC folder] Check data (*.txt) and events (*.eve). Exit code 1 if problems are found. --rules selects rule groups (default src; rule findings of the information level do not affect the exit code). --list-rules lists the rules srcsharp play <event file> [--script file.play] [--out directory] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] [--steps count] [--skip-wait] Run a scenario without a screen. Without --script, advance messages and pick the first choice. With --skip-wait, fixed waits (animations, messages, Wait) are skipped. --scenario-root sets the scenario folder (the base of Data, Lib and Continue); by default, an event file in a subfolder without Data uses the nearest parent folder with Data. srcsharp balance <directory or file>... [--format md|csv] [--output file] List unit data stats and outliers srcsharp new <folder> [--title title] [--episodes count] [--app-path SRC folder] [--force] Create a new scenario template (events, maps and data, autoplay script, VS Code settings, CI). When --episodes is 2 or more, creates multiple episodes with intermission and shared events. Existing files are kept (--force overwrites) srcsharp flow [scenario folder or event file] [--format md|mmd|json] [--output file] [--app-path SRC folder] [--scenario-root scenario folder] Trace Continue, next stage, Exec, IntermissionCommand, Load and GameClear across events and output the episode flow diagram (defaults to the current directory) srcsharp trial <scenario folder> [--unit unit] [--pilot pilot] [--enemy unit] [--enemy-pilot pilot] [--level n] [--enemies n] [--list] Create a trial battle event in .srcsharp/trial/ that fights units and pilots from the scenario data against an enemy, and print its path (run it with play or the debugger). --list prints the units and pilots as JSON srcsharp lsp Language Server (stdio) srcsharp dap Debugger (Debug Adapter Protocol, stdio) srcsharp help [topic] [--list] [--search text [--limit count] [--method hybrid|bm25|vector]] [--grep text] [--export directory] Show the SRC# help (reference for data, event commands, functions, etc., Japanese Markdown). --list lists topics, --search finds pages ranked by relevance, --grep prints lines containing the text, --export writes all pages
Common options: --lang <ja|en|zh-Hans|...|auto> Display language. Can also be set with the SRCSHARP_LANG environment variable (the option wins). Default is ja; auto follows the OS setting --log-level <Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error>, -v, -vv Log level (play, lsp, dap). -v is Debug, -vv is Trace. Can also be set with SRCSHARP_LOG_LEVEL. Default is Information --log-dir <folder>, --no-log-file Folder for log files. --no-log-file disables the log file. Can also be set with SRCSHARP_LOG_DIR and SRCSHARP_LOG_FILE (On|Off)
